1.explanation: The problem specifically concerns the rendering of multiline text in labels using the ol.style.Text object. The rendering pipeline for vector feature text labels involves the ol/style/Text.js file, which defines the Text style class and its methods, and src/ol/render/canvas/TextBuilder.js, which handles the actual drawing/rendering of text (including line splitting and spacing) onto the canvas. Any adjustment to how line gaps are handled or exposed as style options would require changes in these files. Other related files might interact with text, but these two directly deal with how text is styled and rendered, including the calculation and control of line spacing. Adjusting these files would be necessary to fix or provide a configurable option for line gap behavior.
1.bug_scenario: The user has reported that when using multiline text labels (e.g., '4.3\nbar') with the ol.style.Text class in OpenLayers, there is unwanted extra space (a gap) between lines starting in version 4.6.4. In version 2.13, there was no such extra gap. The images show this visual difference: text rendered in v4.6.4 has a clear gap between the two lines, while text in v2.13 does not, which is preferred by the user. The bug relates to how multiline text is rendered and styled within feature labels, particularly controlling line spacing/gap, which appears not to be directly configurable via the public API.

2.explanation: The file src/ol/style/Text.js is directly related to the construction, configuration, and styling of text labels (see the example usage in the bug report with ol.style.Text). Any default line height, spacing, or text rendering options for labels are likely set or passed through here. The file src/ol/render/canvas/TextBuilder.js is responsible for rendering styled text onto the canvas, including line-by-line layout. Any changes to the vertical gap (spacing) between lines in multi-line labels would be implemented in this rendering layer, by adjusting drawing instructions or default line heights. Therefore, these files are the main candidates for modification to control or remove the unwanted gap.
2.bug_scenario: The bug report describes an unwanted gap (extra space) between two lines of label text in newer versions (4.6.4 and lower) of OpenLayers, compared to older version 2.13, where the lines are more tightly packed. The attached image visually confirms this difference: in v4.6.4, labels with line breaks have noticeably more vertical space (gap) between lines, while in v2.13, lines appear much closer together. The user would prefer to remove this gap, making multi-line text in labels more compact, as it was in the previous version, or at least make it configurable via the API.
